strategies.name: vwap_break_and_pullback_long
strategies.entry_summary: Trade long only after a penny stock opens/holds below VWAP, then breaks above VWAP with strong volume and an obvious string of green candles. Enter on the subsequent pullback/retest of VWAP (or a nearby key level like a whole-dollar area) as support, looking to buy the bounce rather than chase the H
strategies.exit_summary: Exit by scalping out into the bounce/upward momentum after the pullback entry. No concrete stop-loss, target level, or repeatable exit rule is taught beyond taking profit on the bounce, so the management is only loosely specified.

result.enumeration_note: The video repeatedly teaches one long VWAP-reclaim pullback setup across several examples. A bearish rejection-at-VWAP idea is mentioned only as context/risk warning and is not promoted to a separate strategy because no runnable short entry-plus-exit rules are taught.
